title: Bitter Stir-Fried Vegetables
description: A simple vegetarian stir-fry recipe featuring bitter greens, gooey sauce, and a variety of vegetables. This dish is quick, easy, and nutritious.

ingredients.name: Gooey Sauce (made with non-pork ingredients)
ingredients.notes: See notes for homemade sauce recipe

instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onions and garlic, cook until softened (3-4 minutes).
Add bell peppers, cook until tender (4-5 minutes).
Add bitter greens, cook until wilted (2-3 minutes).
Mix in gooey sauce and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
